title: Yes and no. But mostly yes
body:
I'm quite adhd. This app helps me. I'm not really interested in the bird at all but I like the interface and the completion ... The way you can have tasks repeat on specific days. All that really annoys me is the in app notifications at the bottom... I don't care that I received new outfits. That entire low bar feels redundant.

Second. The plus upgrade seems tempting but are also largely related to the bird which I already don’t care about. I would like the customisable icons and folders with respective colours but this by itself doesn’t justify a €70 purchase. Fixed, maybe. But not yearly.

Add a different ''productive plus'' tier for the same price or lower where some of those lower bar menus dissappear, there's no more in app notification badges and the customization of the current plus is there (categories w colors, icons) and you got me.

title: Dear Finch
body: When I downloaded this for the first time, I went in with all hope and no expectations. I wanted to try anything and everything as long as something might work. And it did. My life didn’t change in the way I expected it to, I didn’t immediately start being the best version of myself who always felt good no matter what. I started out with little tasks like washing my face, which was sometimes difficult for me. That went over to other tasks, like trying to drink water. A goal it’s helped me achieve that made my mental health much better is journaling, because I could not for the life of me do it for myself. Finch motivated me with its cute adventures, its reward system and love. The change, although it also came from within myself, is something I could not imagine today without Finch. I’m striving to become a better person everyday with this app. Developers, I wish you nothing but beauty in every aspect of life. I will pay it forward in the future.

title: Amazing for people with ADHD
body:
I really like this app! It really helped with my forgetfulness. I can make goals for the day but also for the near future and repeat them so I don’t forget them. If you don’t like streaks you can turn it off in the settings. If you don’t like the haptics you can turn them off and so many other things you can change to your own liking.

It’s so well designed and I don’t think I’ll ever give up on the app. Also the guardian system is a beautiful thing. It shows that this app was made with love towards people who really need it.

I do agree with someone else who commented that they’d like notes for the goals. I would love that too, it’s easier to write down what exactly you need for that certain goal or what subject and keep the title of the goal short.

Another good thing. The app works WITHOUT subscription. There are soooo many apps out there that barely work without subscription. The Finch app you can perfectly use without subscription, and if you want certain extra features you can pay. I like this a lot!

The app is very customizable, but if you want you can also just add the goals the app suggests so setting up the app is also catered to your needs and fun.  

Love the visuals, the sound effects, and the and the added layer of taking care of your little pet, brings back the nostalgia. 

Would recommend to everyone: 10/10
